literal: To sight easy man, harsh-worded man if he is not, will highly praise king land.
translation: If a king is easy to access and free from harsh words, the world will highly praise his land.
modern: காண்பதற்கு எளிமையானவனாகவும், கடுமையான சொற்களைப் பேசாதவனாகவும் ஒரு மன்னன் இருந்தால், அவனது நாட்டை உலகம் மிகவும் புகழ்ந்து பேசும்.
explanation: This couplet defines two essential qualities of a great ruler: accessibility and gentle speech. The phrase 'காட்சிக்கு எளியன்' means the king is easy to approach and does not isolate himself from his people. The phrase 'கடுஞ்சொல்லன் அல்லனேல்' means he does not use harsh or abusive words. When a ruler possesses these two virtues, the entire world will look up to and highly praise his land.
